reviews.snippet:
Absolutely fantastic experience at Rallzees Pub, Kalkan! Brilliant atmosphere, excellent drinks, and such a warm, welcoming place to spend the evening. The staff are incredibly friendly, attentive, and always make you feel comfortable.

A huge thank you to Lee, the owner, who is a genuinely lovely man and makes everyone feel like family. His hospitality really makes this pub special.

One thing we especially loved is that you can watch all kinds of live sports here — including tennis, which was very important for my wife as she plays tennis herself. It was great to enjoy the match in such a relaxed and friendly setting.

If you’re in Kalkan and looking for a bar with amazing service, great atmosphere, live sport, and wonderful people, this is definitely the place to visit. Highly recommended — we will definitely come back! 🍻🎾✨

Had such a great time at Rallzees -  ended up spending quite a few nights there during our holiday and it quickly became our favourite bar! The atmosphere is always lively and welcoming, and the staff and owners are genuinely some of the friendliest people you’ll meet. They really make you feel at home from the minute you walk in.

The cocktails are fantastic (definitely worth trying a few!), the music is always great, and having a pool table and darts board makes it such a fun place to spend the evening. Whether you’re just stopping in for a drink or staying all night, it’s got a brilliant vibe.

If you’re in Kalkan and looking for a fun, friendly bar with great drinks and a good atmosphere, definitely recommend giving Rallzees a visit!

The best bar in Kalkan. Lovely owners, great bar, very stylish sports bar, my friend Apo who owns the best clothing shop says this place is the best and I have to agree. I’ve never had so much fun in my life. Now… as for the cocktails they are the best in the world, they are made by the most beautiful woman in the world too

Rallzes Pub is truly a standout spot in Kalkan for anyone looking to have a great time. The drinks are delicious and carefully prepared, and the prices are quite tourist-friendly compared to the area. What really makes this place special is the owners and their management style — they are professional, attentive, and genuinely care about customer satisfaction.

The venue successfully blends a pub and club atmosphere; whether you want to enjoy a relaxed drink or dance and have fun with great music, you can experience both here. It has a lively, welcoming vibe that makes you want to come back again.
